summary: A shader cache that survives on a Mac, a safer cache file, and upstream's Mod Store.

changes.title: Shader cache kept on a Mac
changes.body: On macOS the graphics driver's shader cache is no longer thrown away the second time you start a game. It loads, and the game is on screen a few seconds sooner. The first start after updating prepares the shaders once more.

changes.title: A safer shader cache file
changes.body: Saving the driver's shader cache while a shader is being built no longer replaces a good file with an empty one, and a shader precache is marked as done only once its work is on disk.

changes.title: Precompiled shaders from another device
changes.body: A precompiled shader store made on a different kind of device (a PC's on a Mac, for example) now says so in the log, instead of counting those shaders as ready.

changes.title: Mod Store
changes.body: From Lichii nx2: browse and install mods from the desktop app.

changes.title: Also from nx2
changes.body: Large ASTC texture arrays are decoded in batches, FlyHigh frame generation is available as a Windows opt-in, and a hung GPU driver can be reported instead of freezing the app (opt-in).

changes.title: About this build
changes.body: This is a build of the zelda branch of danieljesus/Lichii, not an official Lichii release. Reopen these notes anytime from Help, even offline.
